description: Call an operation from sb_api_find (id), or a route the catalog lacks (method+path); dry run by default. pick selects fields, max_items caps lists, item_offset skips items. Lists over 60 KB say so.

dry_run.description: Defaults to true. Pass false to actually send.

file.description: Local file: multipart upload (field "file"); on a GET, saves the answer there

if_match.description: If-Match version; shipping-config reads it itself

item_offset.description: Offset within this response, after API paging. Reads only.

merge.description: PUT: deep-merge body over the current record (arrays replace)

method.description: With path, when id is absent: GET|HEAD|POST|PUT|PATCH|DELETE

path.description: Bare platform path, e.g. "/api/sites/{siteId}/published"; {siteId} defaults to SB_SITE

pick.description: Fields per list item or in a {"product":{…}} answer; dotted: "variants.id"

name: sb_api_call
